trade_row.eventDescription: One Kalshi fill: time, market, taker side, contracts, YES and NO price, price paid and dollar size. A run that finds nothing is free.

candle_row.eventDescription: One 1-minute, 1-hour or 1-day candle for one Kalshi market: open, high, low, close, closing bid and ask, volume and open interest.
